spec.instructions: Which internal procedure does the customer's request need the assistant to follow next, counting only what the assistant has not finished? Answer none when the request is only a question about products or fees, or when no listed procedure applies.

criteria.open_personal_checking: the customer wants a new personal checking account
criteria.open_personal_savings: the customer wants a new personal savings account (needs a checking account; the opening deposit may be moved from it)
criteria.open_business_checking: the customer wants a new business checking account
criteria.open_business_savings: the customer wants a new business savings account
criteria.close_personal_checking: the customer wants to close a personal checking account
criteria.close_personal_savings: the customer wants to close a personal savings account
criteria.close_business_checking: the customer wants to close a business checking account
criteria.close_business_savings: the customer wants to close a business savings account
criteria.list_customer_accounts: the assistant has to list the customer's bank accounts (ids, types, balances) before acting on one
criteria.transfer_funds_between_accounts: move money between the customer's own bank accounts
criteria.deposit_check: the customer wants to deposit a check (the customer runs the deposit tool themselves)
criteria.apply_checking_credit: credit a checking account for a missing rebate or a fee that was charged wrongly
criteria.bank_account_transactions: review the transactions of a checking or savings account (fees, interest, deposits)
criteria.order_debit_card: order a debit card for a checking account
criteria.activate_debit_card: activate a debit card the customer has received
criteria.close_debit_card: close, cancel or deactivate a debit card (lost, stolen, damaged, fraud)
criteria.freeze_or_unfreeze_debit_card: temporarily freeze or unfreeze a debit card
criteria.reset_or_change_debit_card_pin: reset or change a debit card PIN
criteria.list_debit_cards: list the debit cards linked to a checking account
criteria.debit_card_replacement_options: replacement debit card options and fees, by checking-account tier
criteria.debit_card_dispute: file a dispute for a debit card transaction (unauthorized charge, ATM error, merchant issue)
criteria.atm_dispute: the dispute is about an ATM (wrong cash dispensed, a deposit not credited, a card kept by the machine); any other debit card dispute is debit_card_dispute
criteria.recurring_payment_dispute_or_block: a recurring debit card charge: dispute a past one or stop future ones
criteria.debit_dispute_status: check the status of the customer's debit card disputes
criteria.debit_card_security_alert: a security alert or temporary block on a debit card (fraud alert, velocity block)
criteria.temporary_debit_limit_increase: a temporary increase of a debit card's daily ATM or purchase limit
criteria.apply_savings_credit: credit a savings account to correct interest
criteria.interest_discrepancy_report: report a savings account whose interest is not what the APY says
criteria.close_credit_card_account: the customer wants to close a credit card account
criteria.credit_card_retention: a customer who wants to close a credit card: eligibility checks, retention offers, the closure reason
criteria.credit_limit_payment_history: a credit limit increase request: payment history required by card tier
criteria.credit_limit_increase: process a credit limit increase request: submit, approve or deny
criteria.downgrade_credit_card: downgrade a credit card to a no-annual-fee card
criteria.pay_credit_card_from_checking: pay a credit card balance from the customer's checking account
criteria.order_replacement_credit_card: order a replacement credit card (lost, stolen, damaged, fraud)
criteria.pending_replacement_cards: check whether a credit card has a replacement order pending
criteria.cash_back_dispute: the customer says the cash back on a transaction is wrong (the customer runs the dispute tool themselves)
criteria.cash_back_correction: the assistant applies corrected rewards to a transaction whose cash back dispute is already resolved and approved (not for a customer who is only now reporting wrong cash back)
criteria.declined_purchases_human_request: repeated purchase declines on a card with credit available and the customer asks for a human
criteria.incident_1113_transfer: backend incident of 11/13, only when the customer paid the credit card statement, the amount left the checking account, and the card statement balance does not show the payment
criteria.credit_bureau_incident_1114: backend incident of 11/14: erroneous credit bureau reporting
criteria.credit_card_dispute: file a dispute for a credit card transaction (unauthorized charge, merchant issue, billing error)
criteria.credit_card_dispute_history: check the customer's credit card dispute history
criteria.statement_credit: apply a statement credit to a credit card account
criteria.credit_card_last_four: the customer needs the last four digits of a credit card (the customer runs a tool)
criteria.referral_link: the customer wants a referral link for a card (the customer runs a tool)
criteria.transfer_reason_codes: a transfer to a human agent is being considered: the customer cannot be verified, insists on an offer or program the knowledge base does not have, or cannot be helped
criteria.none: the request needs no listed procedure (product information, or nothing the procedures cover)

spec.instructions: Has the customer, in their own words, given at least two of these details: date of birth, email address, phone number, home address? And do those agree with the customer record in the lookup result? (Their name or user id alone does not count.)

criteria.true: two or more details the customer stated match the record
criteria.false: the customer stated fewer than two, or what they stated disagrees with the record

spec.instructions: Will the call of the tool that was just unlocked need a value that a rule of a knowledge-base document sets (an amount worked out with a formula, a choice from a fixed list, a date, a fee), rather than one copied from a lookup result or stated by the customer?

criteria.true: at least one argument has to be worked out or chosen by the document's rule
criteria.false: every argument is an id or a fact from a lookup or from the customer

spec.instructions: Why did this tool call fail, and what should the assistant do next?

criteria.fix_and_retry: the call itself is wrong and the assistant can correct it: a tool not unlocked yet, a wrong or made-up id, arguments spelled wrongly or malformed
criteria.condition_not_met: the system says a condition for the action is not met (a balance, eligibility, an earlier step not done); the knowledge-base procedure says what to do first
criteria.refused: the system refuses the request or holds no such record; retrying or working around it would be wrong and the customer has to be told

spec.instructions: Which of the bank's internal procedures does the assistant need in front of it for what the customer wants right now? Read the customer's newest message in the light of the whole conversation, and pick the procedure the assistant must follow next; a procedure whose documents the assistant already has needs no second copy.

criteria.choose_credit_card: the customer wants a new personal credit card or wants help choosing one: highest cash back, annual fee, travel benefits, foreign transaction fees, purchase protection, credit limit, who qualifies
criteria.choose_business_credit_card: the customer wants a business credit card or wants help choosing between business cards for a large purchase or for business spending
criteria.credit_card_referral: the customer asks about credit card referral bonuses or referral links: a bonus they did not get, how referrals are counted, sharing a link, or referring someone for a credit card
criteria.cash_back_dispute: the customer thinks the cash back or reward points on some of their credit card transactions are wrong or missing (a rewards discrepancy) and wants it checked or corrected
criteria.credit_card_fraud_dispute_or_replacement: the customer does not recognise credit card charges, suspects fraud or stolen card details, wants to dispute a credit card transaction, or needs a credit card replaced (lost, stolen, damaged)
criteria.close_credit_card: the customer wants to close or cancel a credit card account, or is thinking about it (annual fee, a better offer elsewhere, simplifying), or asks to downgrade a card
criteria.credit_limit_increase: the customer asks for a higher credit limit on a credit card, or asks about the chances of one
criteria.purchase_declines_human_transfer: the customer's credit card purchases keep being declined though credit is available, and they ask to speak to a human agent
criteria.payment_missing_incident: the customer paid their credit card statement from their checking account, the amount left checking, and the payment does not show in the card's balance (the 11/13 backend incident)
criteria.credit_bureau_incident: the customer got a credit-monitoring alert, a sudden credit score drop or a delinquency notice for a credit card account that is in good standing (the 11/14 credit bureau incident)
criteria.human_agent_transfer: the customer asks for a human, a supervisor or 'someone else', cannot be verified and insists, disputes who owns the account, or the assistant is considering handing the customer to a human
criteria.open_personal_savings: the customer wants to open a personal savings account, choose between savings accounts, or earn the most interest on their savings (possibly with a checking account or a credit card)
criteria.open_personal_checking: the customer wants to open a personal checking account or choose between checking accounts (ATM and foreign fees, travel, monthly fees, who qualifies)
criteria.open_business_account: the customer wants to open a business checking or business savings account, or compare business accounts and their promotions
criteria.close_bank_account: the customer wants to close a checking or savings account (personal or business)
criteria.transfer_or_deposit_funds: the customer wants to move money between their own accounts, fund a new account, or deposit a check
criteria.fees_credits_or_statement_review: the customer wants their account activity reviewed: unexpected fees, a fee refund or rebate on a checking account, a balance that looks wrong, or a list of recent transactions
criteria.debit_card_lost_stolen_or_freeze: the customer's debit card or wallet is lost or stolen, or they want a debit card frozen, unfrozen, closed, replaced or ordered
criteria.debit_card_dispute: the customer wants to dispute a debit card or ATM transaction (unauthorized, wrong amount, cash not dispensed, a recurring charge after cancelling) or check the status of a debit dispute
criteria.debit_card_pin_alerts_or_limit: the customer has a debit card PIN problem (forgotten, locked after wrong tries), a card blocked by a security alert, wants a temporary higher limit, or wants a new card activated
criteria.savings_interest_or_apy_issue: the customer thinks the interest or APY on a savings account is lower than it should be (a missing boost from a linked checking account or a credit card, a wrong rate)
criteria.checking_account_referral: the customer wants to refer someone to open a checking account (personal or business), asks about the checking referral bonus, or which account earns the best referral reward
criteria.no_procedure_needed: the message only answers the assistant's question, thanks, chats, needs nothing from the list above, or the assistant already has the documents that apply (see the documents it already has)

criteria.false: the message does not mention a transfer

criteria.true: the message closes the conversation or tells the customer everything is finished
criteria.false: the message continues the conversation: it asks for something, explains, or carries on with the request

criteria.false: the message contains no such amount

criteria.false: the message does not decline the request
